idea-plugin.name: Maak
idea-plugin.description:
Run the tasks of a maak.scm from the IDE.

Pick a task, answer the arguments its lambda list takes, and read its output in the Run tool window. The task list is read by maak-tasks, the helper every maak editor integration shares, which understands #:export, docstrings, optional, keyword and rest arguments.

action.description: Pick a task of the nearest maak.scm, answer its arguments and run it
Pick a task and print the commands it would run, instead of running them
Open the procedure that defines a task
